subject: world_language
concept: Writing a literary analysis essay in the target language about an authentic text, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their analysis essay using a thesis/evidence/analysis organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes a literary analysis essay in the target language, making a claim about an authentic text supported by specific evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay presents a clear claim supported by specific textual evidence, written fluently in the target language
misconception_flags: essay summarizes the text's plot rather than making an analytical claim about it

interest_binding: text generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
